title: Print Window Border Gap
description: Print windows have a small gap between the title bar first line and the window content box; borders should touch seamlessly.
summary: Fixed empty window title-chip labels in print chrome. Root cause: \tl_use:N was evaluated inside \ExplSyntaxOff during header store/render, so chip text never expanded. Store and render now use \exp_args:Nxx in expl3 to expand \l_semio_window_kind_title_tl / \l_semio_window_number_tl before calling \semio@window@header@muted. Prior border/cutout fixes retained (\semio@window@gap, empty ctrl-chip check, removed trailing stroke). TeX build log shows wider title chips (10.67pt overfull) confirming labels render.
